title: 2027 Seoul Marathon — overseas race record submission guide
publisher: Seoul Marathon Organizing Committee (The Dong-A Ilbo)
claims: The overseas record submission period is 1 October 2026 10:00 to 30 November 2026 14:00 KST.
Records are submitted through the Dongma Club, World's Marathons or runnet.jp; a valid record is an official full-marathon net time of 4:59:59 or faster from 1 January 2024 to 30 November 2026.
Runners who cannot submit a valid record start in the final wave; record review does not affect whether the registration itself stands.
